module_summary: 32-bit global branch-history shift register: shifts in predictions on predict_valid, reloads from train history on misprediction (priority).

anchors.name: predict_history
anchors.why: History shift register; shifted on prediction, reloaded on misprediction rollback.

anchors.name: predict_valid
anchors.why: Prediction valid; enables shifting predict_taken into history.

anchors.name: train_mispredicted
anchors.why: Flush/rollback request; overrides prediction and reloads history.

anchors.name: train_history
anchors.why: Pre-branch history used to restore the register on misprediction.

anchors.name: predict_taken
anchors.why: Predicted direction bit shifted into history LSB.

anchors.name: train_taken
anchors.why: Actual branch outcome appended to train_history on rollback.

groups.name: history_register
groups.description: Prioritized load/shift of 32-bit history: rollback first, then prediction shift.
